asr.full_text: August ended, this month is a traditionally a lull in the network business. During this time we were preparing updates for the Forsage community. Since September the last the 3rd of the year began and this is on a contrary the most active time and now the opportunities for our partners are expanding more than ever. We have faced many challenges lately. First of all, we are talking about extremely high gas prices, due to which transactions fees on the Ethereum network have grown monstrously. There are numerous haters who have started an information war based on lies, and the appearance of many fakes, copies and imitations of Forsage. But any of our competitors who simply copy our code, our website, our ideas will always be at least one step behind. None of them understood the main idea. Any of them has the opportunity to earn much more as a Forsage partner. Our community is built for members, not creators. There's no VIPs on the top. Many partners earn not even worse than the authors of Forsage, and some even more. The huge turnover of the Forsage community is the income of partners. We decided that we should be independent from any one blockchain, and this is another step towards maximum decentralization. We are already launching updates programs AX3 and AX4 and additional programs will be added which have no analogs in smart contracts yet. The Forsage Academy will also have new opportunities. We will expand the functionality and develop the crypto decentralized ecosystem. Forsage has no Admins, no Chiefs and no Subordinates. There are members of the community. We will follow the example of this CryptoCenter. ForSaj has no admins, no chiefs and no subordinates. They are members of the community. We will form an initiative group which can include any of you. We will publish the details of the conditions and the interaction algorithm in the near future. We have already broken all development records, giving the participants the best opportunities to earn money. Some of the Forsage partners became dollar millonaires within a few months. In the near future, before the end of this year, we will break new records, and remember the only official site is located at www.forsash.io

evidence.quote: Some of the Forsage partners became dollar millonaires within a few months.
Contact me, I will explain in detail how to properly register.

textual.context: Promotional context is indicated by the discussion of expanding opportunities for partners and registration. The source does not establish whether the earnings claim is accurate.
textual.potential_relevance: A large promised financial return is linked to becoming a Forsage partner and contacting the speaker for registration, which may require later assessment of the participation and payment conditions.
textual.limitations: The records do not specify fees, required transfers, eligibility conditions, actual earnings, or whether the registration process was completed.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes Forsage as a network opportunity in which partner income is tied to community turnover and claims that participants became dollar millionaires within months. The speaker presents expanding earning opportunities, directs viewers to register through the contact information, and encourages participation rather than reporting on or critically examining the scheme.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the video describes a multi-person network/community structure whose turnover generates partner income and promotes participation as an earning opportunity. The claims about partners becoming millionaires within months reinforce recruitment-oriented earnings messaging.
